_why: Spec 1.5: `groundable: false` on the header means no content in that Artifact may be cited in a Ground. Spec 2.7 invites communities to declare non-groundable Artifacts under their own type names, so the guarantee cannot rest on the three type names the specification happens to list. Before this fixture the checker enforced the type and ignored the property, and the documented extensibility path published a promise it did not keep.

artifact.name: agent_vega_researcher_goal_ground_v1
artifact.title: Grounding on an Artifact that declares itself non-groundable
artifact.rationale: The Ground addresses a `text` property of an Artifact whose header declares `groundable: false`. Its type is not one of the three the specification names, which is exactly the case this fixture exists for.
